    94| ## How it works
    95| 
    96| - `bin/code` → `src/launcher.ts`.

   100| - `src/server.ts` owns the queue, concurrency, cancellation, task JSON, and event

   103|   `Kernel` with `prelude="all"` and streams each code cell, turn, and observation back
   104|   to the server as `@@TUI@@`-prefixed JSON lines.
   105| - `src/list-model.ts` is the pure ordering / row / scroll model.

   107|   in-memory state and reconnects every second on close. There is no TUI-side database.
